# Adobe Podcast

> AI-powered platform for recording, editing, and enhancing podcast audio with speech transcription, noise removal, and video captioning tools.

Adobe Podcast provides creators with free and premium tools for professional audio production, including speech enhancement, transcription, and editing capabilities. The platform supports multiple languages and offers both web-based and collaborative recording features for podcasters of all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Speech Enhancement
- Audio Editing
- Transcription
- Noise Removal
- Video Captions
- Podcast Recording
- Adobe Podcast Studio
- AI Audio Enhancement
- Voice Clarity
- Audiogram Creation
- Premium Features
- Multi-language Support
- Guest Collaboration
- Short-form Content
- Sound Design

## Core Tools & Features

- [Enhance Speech v2](https://podcast.adobe.com/en/enhance-speech-v2): Free AI-powered speech enhancement tool for cleaning and improving audio quality with noise removal
- [Transcribe Audio with Adobe Podcast](https://podcast.adobe.com/en/transcribe-audio-with-adobe-podcast): Multi-language audio transcription tool with accurate speech-to-text conversion
- [Record Your Podcast](https://podcast.adobe.com/fil/record-your-podcast-for-free): Free podcast recording with guest collaboration and remote recording capabilities
- [Edit Audio Files](https://podcast.adobe.com/es/edit-audio-with-adobe-podcast): Text-based audio editing interface for professional podcast production
- [Add Captions to Video](https://podcast.adobe.com/it/add-captions-to-video-with-adobe-podcast): Auto-captioning and video customization tools for enhanced accessibility
- [Convert Audio to Video](https://podcast.adobe.com/fil/convert-audio-to-video-with-adobe-podcast): Audiogram creation and caption generation for social media distribution

## Learning Guides & Tutorials

- [From Rough to Ready: A Beginner's Guide to Podcast Editing](https://podcast.adobe.com/en/guides/from-rough-to-ready-a-beginners-guide-to-podcast-editing): Essential podcast editing tips and techniques for new creators
- [Podcast Sound Design](https://podcast.adobe.com/en/guides/podcast-sound-design): Guide to building immersive and professional audio experiences for podcasts
- [How to Get the Most Out of Your Short-Form Content](https://podcast.adobe.com/en/guides/how-to-get-the-most-out-of-your-short-form-content): Strategy guide for extending reach and engagement with short-form clips
- [Adobe Podcast Events](https://podcast.adobe.com/en/guides/adobe-podcast-events): Live sessions and expert tips for mastering Adobe Podcast features

## Localized Versions

- [Adobe Podcast - Indonesian](https://podcast.adobe.com/id): Indonesian homepage for AI recording and editing with full platform access
- [Adobe Podcast - Italian](https://podcast.adobe.com/it): Italian homepage for AI-powered audio recording and editing platform
- [Enhance Speech v2 - Turkish](https://podcast.adobe.com/tr/enhance-speech-v2): Turkish version of speech enhancement tool for audio cleaning
- [Enhance Speech v2 - German](https://podcast.adobe.com/de/enhancespeech): German version of free AI audio filter for speech enhancement
- [Enhance Speech v2 - Bengali](https://podcast.adobe.com/bn/enhance-speech-v2): Bengali version of AI-powered speech enhancement tool
- [Edit Audio - Spanish](https://podcast.adobe.com/es/edit-audio-with-adobe-podcast): Spanish guide to text-based audio editing for podcasters
- [Add Captions - Spanish](https://podcast.adobe.com/es/add-captions-to-video-with-adobe-podcast): Spanish guide for video captioning and personalization
- [Record Podcast - Spanish](https://podcast.adobe.com/es/record-your-podcast-for-free): Spanish guide for free podcast recording with remote guest support

- [What's New in Adobe Podcast?](https://podcast.adobe.com/en/guides/whats-new-in-adobe-podcast-march-2026): March 2026 feature updates including Enhance Speech v2 and Studio improvements
